settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_body: The whole crew is ready for the corner you see most.
settings.moods_title: A familiar face in every color.
settings.moods_body: The full eight-piece collection comes together.
settings.personality_body: Keep your favorites in your line of sight and the rest nearby. Plan around the approximately eight-inch plushes, allowing room for ears and hoods.
